verses.original: γὰρ Θέλω ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον ἀγῶνα ἔχω ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν μου τὸ πρόσωπόν ἐν σαρκί
verses.transliteration: gar Thelō hymas eidenai hēlikon agōna echō hyper hymōn kai tōn en Laodikeia kai hosoi ouch heorakan mou to prosōpon en sarki
verses.literal: For I want you to know how much vvv I am struggling for you and [for] those at Laodicea and for all who vvv have not met me - face to face . . . . . .

verses.original: ἵνα παρακληθῶσιν αὐτῶν αἱ καρδίαι συμβιβασθέντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰς πᾶν πλοῦτος τῆς πληροφορίας τῆς συνέσεως εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina paraklēthōsin autōn hai kardiai symbibasthentes en agapē kai eis pan ploutos tēs plērophorias tēs syneseōs eis epignōsin tou mystēriou tou Theou Christou
verses.literal: that they may be encouraged - - in heart knit together in love and filled with vvv [the] full riches - of complete - understanding so that they may know the mystery - of God [namely] Christ

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ εἰσιν ἀπόκρυφοι πάντες οἱ θησαυροὶ τῆς σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως
verses.transliteration: en hō eisin apokryphoi pantes hoi thēsauroi tēs sophias kai gnōseōs
verses.literal: in whom are hidden all the treasures - of wisdom and knowledge

verses.original: λέγω Τοῦτο ἵνα μηδεὶς παραλογίζηται ὑμᾶς ἐν πιθανολογίᾳ
verses.transliteration: legō Touto hina mēdeis paralogizētai hymas en pithanologia
verses.literal: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ εἰ ἄπειμι τῇ σαρκὶ ἀλλὰ εἰμι σὺν ὑμῖν τῷ πνεύματι χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ ὑμῶν τὸ στερέωμα τῆς πίστεως εἰς Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: gar kai ei apeimi tē sarki alla eimi syn hymin tō pneumati chairōn kai blepōn hymōn tēn taxin kai hymōn to stereōma tēs pisteōs eis Christon
verses.literal: For although . . . I am absent from you in body - I am present with you - in spirit [and] I delight - to see your - orderly condition and - - firm - faith in Christ

verses.original: οὖν Ὡς παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν Κύριον περιπατεῖτε ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: oun Hōs parelabete ton Christon Iēsoun ton Kyrion peripateite en autō
verses.literal: Therefore just as you have received - Christ Jesus [as] Lord continue to walk in Him

verses.original: ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ
verses.transliteration: errizōmenoi kai epoikodomoumenoi en autō kai bebaioumenoi tē pistei kathōs edidachthēte perisseuontes en eucharistia
verses.literal: rooted and built up in Him - established in the faith as you were taught [and] overflowing with thankfulness

verses.original: Βλέπετε μή ἔσται τις ὁ συλαγωγῶν ὑμᾶς διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν τῶν ἀνθρώπων παράδοσιν κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: Blepete mē estai tis ho sylagōgōn hymas dia tēs philosophias kai kenēs apatēs kata tēn tōn anthrōpōn paradosin kata ta stoicheia tou kosmou kai ou kata Christon
verses.literal: See to it that no one . . . . . . - takes you captive . . . through - philosophy and empty deception which are based on - vvv human tradition [and] the spiritual forces of the world vvv rather than on Christ

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς Θεότητος κατοικεῖ σωματικῶς
verses.transliteration: hoti en autō pan to plērōma tēs Theotētos katoikei sōmatikōs
verses.literal: For in [Christ] all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form

verses.original: καὶ ἐστὲ πεπληρωμένοι ἐν αὐτῷ ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας
verses.transliteration: kai este peplērōmenoi en autō hos estin hē kephalē pasēs archēs kai exousias
verses.literal: And you have been made complete in [Christ] who is the head over every ruler and authority

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ τῆς σαρκός σώματος ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ
verses.transliteration: en hō kai perietmēthēte en tē apekdysei tou tēs sarkos sōmatos en tē peritomē tou Christou peritomē acheiropoiētō
verses.literal: In Him vvv you were also circumcised in the putting off of [your] vvv sinful nature . . . with the circumcision - [performed] by Christ [and] not by human hands

verses.original: καὶ συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτισμῷ ἐν ᾧ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: kai syntaphentes autō en tō baptismō en hō synēgerthēte dia tēs pisteōs tēs energeias tou Theou tou egeirantos auton ek nekrōn
verses.literal: And having been buried with Him in - baptism - - you were raised with [Him] through [your] faith in the power - of God who raised Him from the dead

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ ὑμῶν τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμᾶς συνεζωοποίησεν σὺν αὐτῷ χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα
verses.transliteration: Kai hymas ontas nekrous en tois paraptōmasin kai tē akrobystia hymōn tēs sarkos hymas synezōopoiēsen syn autō charisamenos hēmin panta ta paraptōmata
verses.literal: [When] you were dead in [your] trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your - sinful nature vvv God made you alive with [Christ] He forgave us all [our] trespasses

verses.original: ἐξαλείψας τὸ χειρόγραφον καθ’ ἡμῶν τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν καὶ ἦρκεν αὐτὸ ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ
verses.transliteration: exaleipsas to cheirographon kath’ hēmōn tois dogmasin ho ēn hypenantion hēmin kai ērken auto ek tou mesou prosēlōsas auto tō staurō
verses.literal: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us - He took it away . . . . . . nailing it to the cross

verses.original: ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: apekdysamenos tas archas kai tas exousias edeigmatisen en parrēsia thriambeusas autous en autō
verses.literal: [And] having disarmed the powers and - authorities He made a public spectacle [of them] . . . . . . triumphing over them by [the cross]

verses.original: οὖν Μὴ τις κρινέτω ὑμᾶς ἐν βρώσει καὶ ἐν πόσει ἢ ἐν μέρει ἑορτῆς ἢ νεομηνίας ἢ σαββάτων
verses.transliteration: oun Mē tis krinetō hymas en brōsei kai en posei ē en merei heortēs ē neomēnias ē sabbatōn
verses.literal: Therefore {let} no one judge you by what you eat or - drink or with regard to a feast - a New Moon or a Sabbath

verses.original: ἅ ἐστιν σκιὰ τῶν μελλόντων δὲ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ha estin skia tōn mellontōn de to sōma tou Christou
verses.literal: These are a shadow of the things to come but the body [ that casts it ] belongs to Christ

verses.original: μηδεὶς θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ θρησκείᾳ τῶν ἀγγέλων καταβραβευέτω ὑμᾶς ἐμβατεύων ἃ ἑόρακεν φυσιούμενος εἰκῇ ὑπὸ αὐτοῦ τῆς σαρκὸς τοῦ νοὸς
verses.transliteration: mēdeis thelōn en tapeinophrosynē kai thrēskeia tōn angelōn katabrabeuetō hymas embateuōn ha heoraken physioumenos eikē hypo autou tēs sarkos tou noos
verses.literal: [Do not let anyone] who delights in [false] humility and [the] worship - of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen [Such a person] is puffed up without basis by his vvv unspiritual - mind

verses.original: καὶ οὐ κρατῶν τὴν Κεφαλήν ἐξ οὗ τὸ πᾶν σῶμα ἐπιχορηγούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον διὰ τῶν ἁφῶν καὶ συνδέσμων αὔξει τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ αὔξησιν
verses.transliteration: kai ou kratōn tēn Kephalēn ex hou to pan sōma epichorēgoumenon kai symbibazomenon dia tōn haphōn kai syndesmōn auxei tēn tou Theou auxēsin
verses.literal: - vvv He has lost connection to the head from whom the whole body supported and knit together by [its] joints and ligaments grows as - God causes it to grow

verses.original: Εἰ ἀπεθάνετε σὺν Χριστῷ ἀπὸ τῶν στοιχείων τοῦ κόσμου τί ὡς ζῶντες ἐν κόσμῳ δογματίζεσθε
verses.transliteration: Ei apethanete syn Christō apo tōn stoicheiōn tou kosmou ti hōs zōntes en kosmō dogmatizesthe
verses.literal: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world why as though you still belonged to [the] world do you submit to [its] regulations

verses.original: Μὴ ἅψῃ μηδὲ γεύσῃ μηδὲ θίγῃς
verses.transliteration: Mē hapsē mēde geusē mēde thigēs
verses.literal: {Do} not handle {do} not taste {do} not touch

verses.original: ἅ ἐστιν πάντα εἰς φθορὰν τῇ ἀποχρήσει κατὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὰ ἐντάλματα καὶ διδασκαλίας
verses.transliteration: ha estin panta eis phthoran tē apochrēsei kata tōn anthrōpōn ta entalmata kai didaskalias
verses.literal: [These] will all - perish with use because they are based on vvv human - commands and teachings

verses.original: ἅτινά μὲν ἔχοντα λόγον σοφίας ἐν ἐθελοθρησκίᾳ καὶ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀφειδίᾳ σώματος ἐστιν ἐν οὐκ τινι τιμῇ πρὸς πλησμονὴν τῆς σαρκός
verses.transliteration: hatina men echonta logon sophias en ethelothrēskia kai tapeinophrosynē kai apheidia sōmatos estin en ouk tini timē pros plēsmonēn tēs sarkos
verses.literal: Such [restrictions] indeed have an appearance of wisdom with [their] self-prescribed worship - [their false] humility and [their] harsh treatment of [the] body [but] they are of no - value against [the] indulgence of the flesh
